steps.speaker: Guard A
steps.content: Unconscious guards found. The east exit has been blocked. Over.

steps.speaker: Guard B
steps.content: Hostage survival confirmed. The west exit has been blocked. Over.

steps.speaker: Guard C
steps.content: Snipers are in position and have locked onto the suspect. Ready to breach at any time.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Copy that.
You have reached the hostage's location and have surrounded the site. Everyone is holding breath, waiting for your next command.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, what should we do next?
Anything that would threaten the lives of the hostage and the suspect would be a bad idea. Besides, if the raid team gets hypnotized, we'll be in big trouble.
I'll go in and distract her to create a window of opportunity for you.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: No, that's too dangerous.
My shackles can at least limit some of her abilities. And... I'm sure you'll keep the chief of the MBCC from danger.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...I see.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Understood! All teams at my command...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Three...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Two...

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Chief!
From the communications device comes a familiar voice that catches even Nightingale off guard.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Relax, one of your subordinates "voluntarily" gave me the communications device. Oh, and I did not hurt him.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Let's have a chat, Chief. Face to face.
Then she hangs up as if she does not care about your answer or already knows what you will do.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Don't go, Chief. This is obviously a trap.
I know that... but since she has the confidence to provoke us, I'm sure she's done her preparations.
Rather than be at a disadvantage during the breach, let's do as she says and see what she really wants.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...I understand. I will have the troops stand by.
Nightingale shoves her sidearm into your hand.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Just in case.

You do not make any more chatter. 
After seeing Nightingale relay the orders, you hide your sidearm in your overcoat and enter the depot alone.
The situation becomes clearer as you slowly approach your target, step by step.
The hostage, Oris, is tied to a chair in a semi-conscious state. He looks dazed and is drooling at the mouth.
Chameleon is standing no more than a foot away from the hostage, admiring her masterpiece.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: I've been waiting for a while, Chief!

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Let me see what you recall. Is it that wonderful night that I orchestrated?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Shh, it's not time for questions yet.
Her index finger is placed at her mouth to make the gesture of silence. You can clearly see the damned pocket watch still hanging around her hand.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Come, let me introduce to you. This is Oris, 35 years old, former secretary of a councilor and a self-made man who married into the Jacknal family.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Take a guess, Chief, as to what secret this man has that he had to kill his psychologists.
It was not recorded in the 9th's documents.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: That's because his story does not deserve to be recorded. He couldn't resist his repeated desire to cheat and feared losing the protection of his fiancée's family.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: How ridiculous that this made him anxious and lose sleep.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: My parents' treatment was perfect. I witnessed it in the clock cabinet. All he had to do was go back to sleep to forget all this unpleasantness.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: However, he decided to lift the sculpture and smash it onto...

Chameleon takes a deep breath and looks up at the roof of the old depot. 
The sun never shines here.
You've already taken everything he values most: his wife, his status, and his power. Is that not enough?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Taken away? I've only allowed the people around him to see his true colors. How is that enough?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: I will turn him into a ghost in the sea of fire, forever repenting in hell for his sins.
Chameleon lifts his chin with her fingers and scrutinizes every inch of the hostage's pale face.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Didn't you ask me just now, Chief, why I didn't run away?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: That's because...

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: It would be a shame if there were no audience for such a wonderful show.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Shh, it's not time for questions yet.
Her index finger is placed at her mouth to make the gesture of silence. You can clearly see the damned pocket watch still hanging around her hand.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Come, let me introduce to you. This is Oris, 35 years old, former secretary of a councilor and a self-made man of the Paradeisos.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Take a guess, Chief, as to what secret this man has that he had to kill his psychologists.
It was not recorded in the 9th's documents.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: That's because his story does not deserve to be recorded. He couldn't resist his repeated desire to cheat and feared losing the protection of his fiancée's family.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: How ridiculous that this made him anxious and lose sleep.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: My parents' treatment was perfect. I witnessed it in the clock cabinet. All he had to do was go back to sleep to forget all this unpleasantness.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: However, he decided to lift the sculpture and smash it onto...

Chameleon takes a deep breath and looks up at the roof of the old depot. 
The sun never shines here.
You've already taken everything he values most: his wife, his status, and his power. Is that not enough?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Taken away? I've only allowed the people around him to see his true colors. How is that enough?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: I will turn him into a ghost in the sea of fire, forever repenting in hell for his sins.
Chameleon lifts his chin with her fingers and scrutinizes every inch of the hostage's pale face.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Didn't you ask me just now, Chief, why I didn't kill him?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: That's because...

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: We will need the cooperation of actors to achieve a wonderful performance.
Performance?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content:
Last time, the audience was nosy and took my actor.
This time, you wouldn't want to miss it. This performance will show the wicked falling into the abyss.
By "wicked," is she referring to Oris or herself?
You do not make it on time to ask this question as you hear clanking from the pocket watch flap.

steps.speaker: Oris
steps.content: Fire!! I'm burning!!
Oris begins to struggle violently while screaming incoherently.

steps.speaker: Oris
steps.content: H-HELP ME! HELP! HELP ME!

steps.speaker: Oris
steps.content: I admit I was wrong! T-there's no exit!

steps.speaker: Oris
steps.content: It's you guys again... Don't come any closer! Don't come any closer!
His wrists rub against the rope, bleeding. But Oris seems unable to perceive the pain and continues jerking his body with all his might, fighting with an invisible enemy.

options: What have you done to him?!

choices.text: What have you done to him?!

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: I tailored a nightmare for him.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: This dream has no end but only a sea of flames and countless sharp blades forged by my hatred.
This is mental abuse!

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Hahahahah, why do you seem so surprised?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Hahahahahah, he's already entered the mind maze I tailored for him. A nightmare of an endless sea of flames. Revenge without an end.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Stop? Pfft, did you actually think I would stop?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Looks like that woman is playing the game of checks and balances... Didn't she tell you?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: The reason why the 9th would not let me approach the hostage.
Chameleon dips her fingertips into the blood flowing from the hostage's wrists and holds it to her mouth with a look of intoxicating pleasure.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Then let me tell you personally...

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: I am one of the best hypnotists in the DisCity, a professor of psychology at Banyan Medical College, a psychological consultant at 9th, and at the same time...

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: I'm also a psychopath that thrives on schadenfreude, hahahahahah.
Chameleon's presumptuous laughter sends a chill down your spine.
You might be too late: the hostage—or the "key"—has unlocked the dangerous door to Chameleon's madness.
Even though you failed to stop her from hypnotizing the hostage, you can at least end the abuse!
The dark glow flows in your palm, but the situation has not changed in the slightest. Oris is still screaming and struggling.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Heheh, Chief. Looks like those shackles you're proud of have failed you.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Do you know why?
Chameleon leans in close towards you, her voice trying to lead you.
After two hypnosis sessions, you know you should ignore what she has to say.

options: Try to unleash the shackles again!

choices.text: Try to unleash the shackles again!

steps.content: You ignore Chameleon, but you still fail to unleash the shackles.

steps.speaker: Oris
steps.content: Fire!! Everything is in flames!! Let me out!

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: This is the perfect toy for me. All of my pain is caused by him, and all of his pain is forged by me...

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: My toy is calling for your help! But why can't you even use the shackles that you're so good at?
She disguises her schadenfreude as concern.

options: Ignore her. Continue unleashing the shackles!

choices.text: Ignore her. Continue unleashing the shackles!

steps.content: Sure enough, it still fails.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Have you ever wondered about the anomaly?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Is it possible that this is not the world you are familiar with?
Your reason tells you that you failed because your subconscious mind remembers that "Chameleon can manipulate you to unfasten the shackles." You must not let her words lead you.
But at the same time, the skepticism caused by the two hypnosis sessions makes you wonder whether everything here is fake.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: That's right, could it all be fake?
She seems to be able to read your mind.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: From the moment I closed my pocket watch, from the moment you stepped foot into the depot, and from the moment you brought your men to surround this place, you—all of you—have been stuck in the dream that I prepared!

options: Could this really be a dream?

choices.text: Could this really be a dream?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: How can you be so sure? Maybe this false life is an illusory dream in itself.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Yes, this false life is just an illusory dream, hahaha.
At the sound of her laughter, the ground begins to tilt, the walls distort and Chameleon's voice starts to get muddled.
The hypnosis this time is much more powerful than ever. Although you repeatedly tell yourself that everything is an illusion, you still feel a splitting headache.
Your last shred of sanity allows you to feel for the pistol hidden in your coat.
Looks like you've got to give it a shot.
Bang!!
You only hit Chameleon in the thigh as you are wobbling. Everything stabilizes for a moment after the gunshot.

options: Use this opportunity to unleash the shackles again!

choices.text: Use this opportunity to unleash the shackles again!

steps.content: Interrupting the hypnosis by attacking the hypnotist boosts your confidence. The shackles are released and the hostage is no longer struggling.
You hypnotized me twice and I retaliated once. I think is quite fair.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Interesting...
What?
Only now do you notice that Chameleon is not concerned at all about her wounds or the hostage. Her face glows with a look of strange ecstasy as she keeps her eyes glued to you.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: I thought it was not true that the shackles could connect to the spiritual world, but just now, I saw it—

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: A world more fascinating than the abyss of pain. That was your deep spiritual world.
Stop playing tricks. I don't want to hurt you anymore.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: No, you do! The moment you were about to pull the trigger, all you had in your mind was how to shoot and kill me.
Chameleon's voice is surprisingly calm, but you can tell that compared to the usual well-disguised psychologist, this one has a lot more deep emotions mixed into it.
You can't deny that you had the intention to kill her when you pointed the gun at her and that you were disappointed when your shot only hit her thigh.
During this silence, Nightingale arrives with her men.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief! Are you hurt?!

options: I'm good. Deal with the hostage first.

choices.text: I'm good. Deal with the hostage first.

steps.content: Send Oris back to the 9th and never ever tell me where they will be hiding him.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Hide him? Hahahah... You've already experienced the pleasure of malice and you're still trying to pretend?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: What you're thinking right now is clear: "If only Chameleon had killed the hostage!"
I'm not.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: You can't wait for me and that loser Oris to disappear from this world.
That's enough!

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Hahahah, admit it. You and I are the same. We're both selfish.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: The seeds of evil have been planted in your subconscious world, slowly taking root...

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Slowly sprouting...
Bang!!
A bullet goes through your thigh and the sharp pain brings you back to your senses immediately. There are no longer any floating walls or floors, just a hostage needing to be freed.

options: Use this opportunity to unleash the shackles again!

choices.text: Use this opportunity to unleash the shackles again!

steps.content: The sensation of pain stimulates your perception and crisis awareness. The shackles are successfully released and the hostage is no longer struggling.
Nightingale, who hears the gunshot, rushes in with her men and escorts slumped Oris out of the door.
The guards surround Chameleon, but she is unfazed. All of her attention is directed toward you.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: You actually woke up... using this method? Hah...
She looks at your bleeding gun wound incredulously. Just as she tries to touch it, she is stopped by the guards raising their guns.
Don't resist. You no longer have any advantages.
She looks around. After realizing her situation, she drops her gaze back at you.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Interesting... Hahaha, how interesting...

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Still sounding tough even with a gunshot wound, huh... You've sure grown a lot, Chief.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: You're no longer the same greenhorn who could be meekly hypnotized.
Chameleon's voice is surprisingly calm. You seem to see the gentle and kind doctor of the past in this psychopath. Unfortunately, that gentle doctor was a mere facade.
I'm already able to resist hypnosis on my own. You've lost your last bargaining chip. Just surrender.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Sure, I'll go back with you.
She agrees without thinking and even lets the guards cuff her.
I will send the hostage back to the 9th and hide him in a place that even I don't know about...

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: It doesn't matter anymore.
She smiles and interrupts your explanation.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: I already found a better toy!
What are you trying to pull this time?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Take it easy. I've already lost this round, haven't I? I'm not going to pull any tricks.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: There are still many days ahead of us...

Chameleon was brought back to the Bureau and put under the strict surveillance for an S-class danger.
There, she was playing the role of a psychologist like she was before. She has not mentioned anything related to "hostage" or "psychopath."
It doesn't seem like there will be any more incidents, but you still feel vaguely uneasy.

Your game with her seems to have just begun.
